BrochureContent.Content:
Stanley Estate Agents are delighted to introduce No. 36 Inbhir Ide, Malahide, Co. Dublin to the market.  

No. 36 Inbhir Ide is a spacious three-bedroom end-of-terrace family home, ideally positioned within a mature and highly sought-after residential setting in Malahide. Extending to approximately 110sq.m., the property offers generous and versatile accommodation throughout.  

This property presents an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a well-located Malahide home with superb potential. While the home would benefit from modernisation, it offers a generous layout, excellent internal space and a mature residential setting, allowing the next owner to create a home tailored to their own taste and requirements.  

To the front, the property benefits from a private driveway providing off-street parking, bordered by mature hedging and planting. The front porch/conservatory provides a bright and welcoming additional space, ideal as sitting area or reading room.  The accommodation is well laid out and practical. 

The ground floor comprises a welcoming hallway, comfortable living room with feature fireplace, kitchen/dining room, front porch/conservatory and a substantial rear playroom/family room. This rear space offers excellent flexibility and could suit a variety of uses.  To the rear, the property enjoys a mature garden with lawn, pathway, planting and outdoor seating areas. 

The property also benefits from a substantial shed, providing excellent storage space, together with a separate wet room located off the rear of the house.  Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, comprising two double bedrooms and one single bedroom, along with a shower room. The bedroom accommodation is bright and well proportioned, with built-in storage in two of the bedrooms.  

The location is superb. Inbhir Ide is a mature and convenient residential area within easy reach of Malahide Village, Malahide Castle and Demesne, local schools, shops, cafés, restaurants and excellent transport links. Dublin Airport, the M1, M50, Portmarnock and Swords are also easily accessible, making this a highly convenient and desirable place to live.  

This is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a spacious three-bedroom end-of-terrace home in a well-established Malahide location. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.   

Accommodation:  Porch / Conservatory — Bright porch/conservatory to the front of the property, offering a versatile additional living space. 

Hallway — Welcoming entrance hallway providing access to the main ground floor accommodation. 

Living Room — Comfortable living room with feature fireplace and double doors leading to the front porch/conservatory. 

Kitchen / Dining Room — Spacious kitchen/dining room with fitted units, dining area and feature fireplace. 

Playroom / Family Room — Bright and spacious rear room offering excellent flexibility as a playroom, family room, hobby room or home office. 

Wet Room — Separate wet room located off the rear of the property. 

Shed — Substantial shed providing excellent storage space.   

First Floor Landing — Landing area providing access to all first-floor accommodation. 
Bedroom 1 — Large double bedroom with built-in wardrobes. 
Bedroom 2 — Double bedroom with built-in storage. 
Bedroom 3 — Single bedroom, ideal as a child’s bedroom, guest room or home office. 
Shower Room — Shower room with WC, wash hand basin and shower
